The '''Realm of the Fisher King''' is the name given to a small kingdom located on an inter-dimensional plane alongside that of [[Gielinor]]'s. The area plays a key role in the [[Holy Grail (quest)|Holy Grail]] [[quest]], in which the player is tasked with returning the [[Holy Grail|grail]] to [[Camelot|The Knights of the Round Table]] following Sir Galahad's choice to pardon himself from the order so he could become a monk.

Prior to completion of the quest, the area is ruled by [[The Fisher King]]; however, he is eventually succeeded by Sir Percival upon completion of the quest.

It can be accessed during the quest by blowing the [[magic whistle]] underneath the [[Brimhaven]] watchtower, or may be revisited by the use of [[fairy ring]] code {{fairycode|bjr}}.

==Transportation==
The completion of [[Holy Grail]] up to the point that you are able to pick up the [[Holy grail (item)|Holy grail]] is required to access the Fisher Realm.

*Blowing a [[magic whistle]] under a tower near a horseshoe gold mining spot north-west of [[Brimhaven]].
*[[Fairy ring]] code {{Fairycode|bjr}} teleports on the northern side of the realm.

==History==
{{Map|2784,4704|mapID=10062|align=right|caption=A map of the withered Fisher Realm.}}
When first encountered during the quest, the kingdom is in a state of dilapidation brought on by the illness of the King. The landscape is dead and crops are failing to yield, leaving the sparse number of citizens in the kingdom unhappy. In addition to this, the bridge connecting two parts of the landscape is being occupied by the [[Black Knight Titan]], preventing travel in and out of the grail castle.

After the Black Knight Titan is defeated, it is the player's duty to convince [[Sir Percival]] to succeed his father in the role of king. After much deliberation, Percival accepts the role as king and returns the landscape to a lush, green environment.

==Features==
The Kingdom contains a river that flows through the centre of the area. The area has a modest size, both geographically and population-wise. The only building apart from the Grail Castle is a small shack-like dwelling with a [[Range|cooking range]] inside of it.

=== Grail Castle ===
[[File:Grail Castle.png|none|thumb|width=500x500|The Grail Castle, home of the Fisher King.]]

===Fisher farm===
The farm area contains 3 [[fishing spots]], a pen for [[sheep]] and [[rams]], a [[cabbage]] patch, and some [[wheat]] and [[potato]] fields. One can infer that due to its isolation, the community is self-sustaining via various forms of agriculture and animal husbandry.
[[File:Fisher farm.png|none|thumb|width=500x500|The farm area of the Fisher realm.]]

==Inhabitants==

=== Personalities ===
*The {{Chatl|The Fisher King|text=Fisher King}}, who passes on and turns the land over to his son (only during [[Holy Grail]]).
*{{Chatl|Fisherman (Holy Grail)|text=Fisherman}}, who laments the downfall of the land (only during [[Holy Grail]]).
*6 {{Chatl|Grail Maiden|text=grail maidens}}, who serve the Fisher King.
*5 {{Chatl|Peasant|text=peasants}}, who serve the Fisher King.
*{{Chatl|Sir Percival}}, a [[Camelot|Knight of the Round Table]] who succeeds his father as leader of the realm.

=== Monsters ===
*[[Black Knight Titan]]
*[[Duck]] (x22)
*[[Ram]] (x3)

==Trivia==
*The fact that this realm cannot be reached by conventional means and that Percival later becomes king of it is a reference to a {{wp|King Arthur}} legend where after Sir Percival, Sir Bors, and Sir Galahad find the Holy Grail, Sir Galahad dies, Sir Percival becomes the king of the land surrounding the magic castle holding the Grail (which cannot be found using conventional means), and Sir Bors reports back to King Arthur.
